mentions.name: DroneCraft
mentions.description: A third-person drone exploration game where players scout the world for parts, craft powerful upgrades, and trade strategically to evolve their drone build. Built with Three.js / React Three Fiber; core mechanics are working, a first playable version is planned within a month, and the full codebase will be open-sourced.
